description.value: You hurl a glob of acid at a creature within range, making a ranged spell attack. On hit, the creature takes 4d4 acid damage, and starts to be melted by acid. For 1 minute, at the end of each of its turns, it takes 1d4 acid damage. A creature can end the effect early by using its action to clear off the acid.\n\n

higher_level_description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the initial damage increases by 2d4 for each slot level above 1st.
